description: Returns a page from the jwatte.com website-tool catalog in directory order, filtered by category or matching keywords. Each entry has a slug, title, category, description, source link and takes_url flag indicating whether it supports a browser run link. Includes the total count and next offset; 1 to 20 entries per page.

category.description: Optional category: audits, generators or utilities; absent means all categories.

limit.description: Tools per page (1 to 20, default 10). More results are available using next_offset.

offset.description: Number of entries before this page, matching the previous next_offset value.

search.description: Keywords that must all appear in the title, slug, tags or description, e.g. "schema".

name: list_audit_tools
